title: Allie, Rosemary & the Undead Realm
summary: Su Yung draws Allie and Rosemary into a supernatural story about friendship, fear and sacrifice. Allie’s attempts to save others lead to a tragic ending within Impact’s fictional Undead Realm.

chapters.title: Su Yung wins Last Rites
chapters.result: Su Yung defeats Allie for the Knockouts championship.
chapters.context: After Rosemary’s on-screen destruction, Allie tries to confront her tormentor. The coffin-match loss lets Su Yung extend her hold over the story.

chapters.title: Allie sacrifices herself
chapters.result: Allie takes Su Yung’s attack while protecting Rosemary.
chapters.context: The Undead Realm sequence depicts Allie’s character dying in Rosemary’s arms. This is a scripted supernatural farewell, rather than a real-life death.
